288:     if (words.empty()) {

292:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
293:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
294:         return std::nullopt;
295:     }
296: 
297:     std::vector<Index> matches;
298:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
299:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
300:         bool is_phrase = true;
301: 
302:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
303:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
304:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {

306:             }

308:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {

310:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
311:             });
312: 
313:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
314:                 is_phrase = false;
315:                 break;
316:             }
317: 
318:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);

320: 
321:         if (is_phrase) {
322:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());

411:     const std::string word2 = normalize_word(key2);
412:     if (word1.empty() || word2.empty()) {
413:         return std::nullopt;
414:     }
415: 
416:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
417:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
418:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
419:         return std::nullopt;
420:     }
421: 
422:     std::vector<Index> matches;
423: 
424:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
425:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
426:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.chapter_id != second.chapter_id ||
427:                 first.line != second.line) {
428:                 continue;
429:             }
430: 
431:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
432:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
433:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
434:             if (distance <= dis) {
435:                 matches.push_back(first);

471:         .cur = join_lines(book.lines, cur_begin, cur_end),
